title: Verus Independent-Inference Agreement Rule v1
applies_to: Verified Code Marker independent-inference examination for Verus orbs
run_independence: Each run is a fresh, independent inference pass with no shared state, given the orb's declared capabilities, schema, and observed behavior, judging each declared claim.

marker_verdict.otherwise: trust_state stays provisional (or needs_repair); mismatch_data recorded; never silently upgraded
marker_verdict.principle: AEGIS Canon Axiom 8 (Scrutiny): truth withstands examination; falsehood requires protection; suppression signals fragility.

uncertainty_handling: Uncertain verdicts never count as coherent. If uncertainty keeps a claim below the 4/5 bar, the claim stays provisional pending more evidence.
binding: The agreement record is bound to the exact runtime_hash. Any source change (new hash) voids it and requires a fresh 5-run set.
complementary_gate: The orb's deterministic test suite is complementary behavioral evidence, not a substitute. Both the test suite and the independent-inference agreement are required for a verified trust_state.
grounding: AEGIS Canon Axiom 8 (Scrutiny); Pod-Orb Verified Code Marker 3-5 independent-inference-run working range.
